manual: From a child Workshop's clanker, report a question with a payload; confirm the parent's `watch --once` prints it addressed to the parent Workshop, and that --to and --no-parent override the addressee

During a tool-heavy Claude turn, confirm `status.lastEventAt` advances on each tool call

With Herdr toasts enabled (`[ui.toast] delivery`), report `--state question` from a clanker in a background tab; confirm a notification titled with the state and Workshop title shows the message, that `working` and `done` stay quiet, and that `CLANKERHOUSE_REPORT_NOTIFY=none` silences it

Queue a message to a clanker, then close its pane; confirm `send-status` reports orphaned at once and that the stored message turns orphaned after 30 minutes, after which the daemon stops its 30-second delivery pass
